features.summary: User authentication, SSO sessions and current ownership
invariants: Ownership does not restrict access. Browser sessions and MCP authentication are independent; invalidated browser sessions cannot be reused.
features.change_rule: When authentication or profile contracts change, review Ops actors, the Dashboard relay, new installations, ownership display and user guides together. Review the full installation doctor and step exit criteria when this feature changes; a local health response does not establish user-facing readiness.
live_validation: Verify actual Tailscale clients, Sharing revocation and TLS separately.

interfaces.name: Browser authentication
interfaces.accepts: Trusted Tailscale ingress + native user binding or ready machine share
interfaces.returns: Verified session or rejected login; no provider token in browser

interfaces.name: Caller identity
interfaces.accepts: Signed, expiring Dashboard identity
interfaces.returns: Shared actor with server-selected scopes; invalid/expired assertions rejected

interfaces.name: Current responsibility
interfaces.accepts: Item identity + registered profile + actor
interfaces.returns: Owner overlay and audit row; original item preserved

interfaces.name: Resident agent tokens
interfaces.accepts: Signed Dashboard Admin claim, registered user and allowed scopes
interfaces.returns: One-time permanent token; only digest and revocation metadata persisted

features.summary: Public HTTP/MCP contracts and request routing
invariants: HTTP and the six MCP groups invoke the same operations. Distinguish request acceptance from successful execution.
features.change_rule: When public inputs or responses change, check schemas, examples, API revision, guides and Dashboard consumers. Since ops.py contains multiple feature entry points, narrow impact to the affected functions.
live_validation: Verify actual MCP client compatibility and network disconnections separately.

interfaces.name: Operation dispatch
interfaces.accepts: Validated group/action arguments and authenticated actor
interfaces.returns: Domain response; ValueError/PermissionError at public boundary

interfaces.name: Transport
interfaces.accepts: HTTP or Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC
interfaces.returns: Versioned response/errors; notifications and unsupported methods retain their transport semantics

features.summary: Shared queue ordering, admission and preparation pipelines
invariants: Do not preempt running Jobs. Respect dependencies, allow concurrent preparation and never reassign resources before their return.
features.change_rule: When queue policy changes, verify dispatch, catalog ordering and control capabilities with the same scenarios.
live_validation: Actual long-running GPU workloads and power loss require separate acceptance testing.

interfaces.name: Scheduling decision
interfaces.accepts: Job row + DB dependency/recovery/hold state + lane
interfaces.returns: Eligibility/stage/waiting reason consumed by worker and UI

interfaces.name: Queue mutation
interfaces.accepts: Waiting Job, actor, relative/absolute placement
interfaces.returns: Persisted order and change receipt; running Job not preempted

features.summary: Job lifecycle, script execution and container ownership
invariants: Loom executes Jobs. Release resources based on executor-ticket, container and process return evidence. Never pass platform secrets or Docker sockets into Jobs.
features.change_rule: When execution contracts change, verify the worker, executor, restart/idempotency behavior, cancellation, result collection and Compose mounts. Review the full installation doctor and step exit criteria when this feature changes; a local health response does not establish user-facing readiness.
live_validation: Actual Docker/GPU runtimes and power loss after container creation are outside mock coverage.

interfaces.name: Runtime request
interfaces.accepts: Pinned profile, Job params, stage, input locators
interfaces.returns: Resolved execution request file; invalid paths/inputs rejected before runtime

interfaces.name: Worker lifecycle
interfaces.accepts: Durable queue/config/resource receipts
interfaces.returns: Preparation/run/return/result transitions; no release without resource evidence

features.summary: Recovery reservations, recipient events and retries
invariants: The caller owns error repair. Preserve reservation deadlines, attempt limits and dependent-Job skipping. Event acknowledgments are recipient-specific.
features.change_rule: When state transitions change, check queue dispatch, notification events, claim leases, concurrency and expiry tests. Authoritative transitions live in ops/ops.py worker/finish and ops/recovery.py.
live_validation: Actual external-agent reactivation and duplicate callback effects belong to client acceptance testing.

interfaces.name: Recovery action
interfaces.accepts: Job + actor + claim/progress/resume/defer arguments
interfaces.returns: Incident/lease/attempt transition or conflict; caller edits do not auto-run a new unapproved scope

interfaces.name: Deadline
interfaces.accepts: DB + clock
interfaces.returns: Expired reservation no longer blocks unrelated Jobs; dependent Jobs remain ineligible

features.summary: Artifact registration, indexing, lineage and metadata contracts
invariants: Distinguish execution completion from indexing completion. Ownership changes must not overwrite original artifact or execution provenance.
features.change_rule: When artifact schemas change, check producers, API/MCP schemas, queue dependency readiness, catalog projections and detail views together.
live_validation: Verify large artifacts and external filesystem failures against actual storage.

interfaces.name: Output validation/index
interfaces.accepts: Returned Job, typed manifest, storage/config, optional prepared facts
interfaces.returns: Registry entities/metrics/lineage or processing error; compute not rerun solely for indexing

features.summary: Components, Tools, Profiles and immutable Runtime environment contracts
invariants: Registering a new component must not require new MCP tools or platform redeployment. Preserve profile revision pins on submitted Jobs.
Runtime metadata is separate from Job state; instance grants and exact revisions are verified, and dependency discovery does not authorize host installation.
features.change_rule: When Profiles, Components, Tools or Runtimes change, review stage pins, dependency requirements, executor grants/policy, API/MCP discovery, Dashboard, configured installation directories and preservation.
live_validation: The execution-environment owner verifies actual external image dependencies, caches and GPU compatibility.

interfaces.name: Dynamic profile
interfaces.accepts: Actor + profile operation/schema + revision/config
interfaces.returns: Stored validated profile revision or reference; submitted Job keeps its pin

interfaces.name: Dynamic component
interfaces.accepts: Actor + component operation/metadata
interfaces.returns: Immutable component revision and namespace; no new MCP server required

interfaces.name: Granted Runtime inventory
interfaces.accepts: Instance executor configuration plus read-only Profile/Job catalog
interfaces.returns: Granted exact Runtime revisions, validation evidence and actual consumers, or explicit unavailable status

interfaces.name: Exact Runtime resolution
interfaces.accepts: Executor state, instance and exact id/revision with optional sealed digest
interfaces.returns: Integrity-checked immutable manifest within instance grant; denies missing/changed revisions

interfaces.name: Profile combinations
interfaces.accepts: Read-only registry and installed config, actor and recorded Jobs
interfaces.returns: Exact software and stage environment combinations with declared/observed usage and current attribution; no execution or Job gate

features.summary: Catalog, preserved records and file access
invariants: Distinguish historical originals from current display overlays. Never assume missing files are valid artifacts.
features.change_rule: When projections change, check revision refresh, detail queries, file MIME/size/path boundaries and the UI. Review the full installation doctor and step exit criteria when this feature changes; a local health response does not establish user-facing readiness.
live_validation: Verify migrated data reference integrity separately from fixtures.

interfaces.name: Dashboard projection
interfaces.accepts: DB, actor, instance config, storage roots
interfaces.returns: Current catalog including Owner overlay and availability facts

interfaces.name: Artifact read
interfaces.accepts: Registered media index/key + allowed storage
interfaces.returns: Bounded allowed file stream or refusal; no arbitrary host path read

invariants: Observations are read-only and do not affect queue dispatch. Preserve missing/stale/partial distinctions.
features.change_rule: When collector fields change, check host mounts, collection services, API projections and UI rendering. Review the full installation doctor and step exit criteria when this feature changes; a local health response does not establish user-facing readiness.
live_validation: Actual OS, kernel, driver and Docker socket responses require live verification.

interfaces.name: Docker observation
interfaces.accepts: Configured Docker command/projects/read scope
interfaces.returns: Read-only container/image snapshot; unavailable facts remain unavailable

invariants: Never send credentials to the opaque iframe. Browser writes respect Origin/CSRF boundaries. The UI must not infer completed backend states.
features.change_rule: Rebuild the generated workspace after UI source edits. Verify both HTTP behavior and real Firefox for authentication, session or relay changes. Review the full installation doctor and step exit criteria when this feature changes; a local health response does not establish user-facing readiness.
live_validation: Actual Safari behavior, existing user sessions and SSO provider login require separate acceptance testing.

interfaces.name: Browser relay
interfaces.accepts: Allowed read route or queue mutation + authenticated browser
interfaces.returns: Bounded response; session/Origin/CSRF guard for writes; no generic arbitrary proxy

interfaces.name: HTTP server
interfaces.accepts: Ops origin, optional SSO config and exact trusted ingress
interfaces.returns: Dashboard server with explicit authentication mode

features.summary: User guides, version identification and client entry
invariants: The running server is authoritative for guides. Updates do not change personal instructions or active Job pins.
features.change_rule: When usage contracts change, update Loom Use documents, bundle inventory, revisions and the stdio client. Review the full installation doctor and step exit criteria when this feature changes; a local health response does not establish user-facing readiness.
live_validation: Verify actual client reconnection and guide refresh separately.

interfaces.name: Guide package
interfaces.accepts: Actor, client-known revision, current schemas/contracts
interfaces.returns: Version-bound guide package and update identity; no automatic credential issuance

features.summary: Tailscale enrollment, Serve and native identity configuration
invariants: New installations keep Dashboard and MCP on private Serve and require a separate public request-only Gateway. tag:loom supports Hub discovery; user grants apply per machine.
tag:loom is Hub discovery only; access approvals target one stable machine/device identity and exact addresses. Public request listener exposes no operational data or MCP.
features.change_rule: When enrollment or proxy behavior changes, verify installation plans, exact trusted peers, callback URLs, reruns/pending approvals, TLS and policy scope. Review the full installation doctor and step exit criteria when this feature changes; a local health response does not establish user-facing readiness.
live_validation: Passing mocks does not replace actual administrator login, device approval or policy permissions.

interfaces.name: Enrollment
interfaces.accepts: Expected tailnet, hostname/tag/SSH preferences
interfaces.returns: Ready or bounded login/approval-wait result; never switches an existing tailnet

interfaces.name: Instance binding
interfaces.accepts: Instance root, validated plan, MagicDNS name
interfaces.returns: Backed-up API auth config and Compose overlay; no implicit restart

interfaces.name: Serve binding
interfaces.accepts: Instance ports and planned HTTPS routes
interfaces.returns: Existing nonconflicting routes retained; collisions fail before route mutation

interfaces.name: Machine access requests
interfaces.accepts: Verified external identity, private admin decision, configured machine and management credential
interfaces.returns: Durable invitation/user approval/exact machine policy state; recoverable failures

features.summary: Preserved data, Job migration and remote ownership
invariants: Distinguish original preservation from current presentation and retain installation identifiers. Cloned installations running concurrently require distinct identities.
features.change_rule: When migration changes, check locator/storage IDs, original hashes, ownership overlays, selective exclusions and rerun idempotency.
live_validation: Verify actual cross-machine TLS/handoff and access to restored data.

interfaces.name: Copy integrity
interfaces.accepts: Source/destination + expected file identity
interfaces.returns: Verified copy or explicit failure; does not reinterpret historical recipes

interfaces.name: Remote fence
interfaces.accepts: DB, actor, action and ownership request
interfaces.returns: Ownership transition/receipt or refusal; controls real execution ownership

features.summary: Compose, host layout, services and immutable builds/releases
invariants: The loom service account, installation UUID and user profiles are independent. Separate dev and alpha databases, ports and data; restart only after execution resources return.
New installation has one service contract: native Tailscale identity, Admin binding, Sharing Gateway, Ops, Dashboard, executor and explicit storage. Token-only fallback is not installation success.
Doctor observes actual state independently of progress receipts. Only explicit smoke submits a Job; diagnostics never repair or grant access. Handoff leads with the verified Gateway URL.
features.change_rule: When adding files or dependencies, check Dockerfiles, snapshots, installer HOST_FILES, Compose mounts and new-installation/upgrade guides.
live_validation: Temporary-filesystem tests do not replace real clean-host installation, reboot and rollback verification.

interfaces.name: Fresh layout
interfaces.accepts: New instance/data paths, ports/images and service identity
interfaces.returns: Owned layout, independent installation UUID and initial config; refuses existing instance overwrite

interfaces.name: Installation workflow
interfaces.accepts: Verified immutable kit + complete installation plan
interfaces.returns: Installed services or explicit enrollment wait/failure; no false success from partial progress

interfaces.name: Idle update / rollback
interfaces.accepts: Verified built release + installed instance; idle Jobs and returned executor tickets
interfaces.returns: Updated images/helpers; overrides and extensions preserved; failure keeps recovery record

interfaces.name: Installation diagnostics
interfaces.accepts: Complete plan and installed instance; optional stage
interfaces.returns: Read-only per-check pass/fail, next step and explicit live-validation limits

interfaces.name: Packaged acceptance Job
interfaces.accepts: Authorized installation and its matching kit
interfaces.returns: Bounded, repeatable CPU prepare/run/result test; never changes queue ordering

features.summary: Feature specifications, impact analysis and isolated test tools
invariants: Development validation adds no new gates to Job execution. Distinguish test results from actual deployment state.
features.change_rule: Register each new feature's unique ID, owned files, inputs/outputs, dependencies, tests and live-validation limitations. Test behavior and failure boundaries rather than adding generic assertions.
live_validation: Passing all tests does not prove successful authentication with actual external services.

interfaces.name: Change impact
interfaces.accepts: Changed repo-relative paths + feature catalog
interfaces.returns: Direct owners, related consumers, tests/specs; no mandatory edits to every consumer

interfaces.name: Catalog check
interfaces.accepts: Catalog + repository tree
interfaces.returns: Missing references, ambiguous owners, unmapped code/tests and broken interface links

features.summary: Optional personal host SSH accounts and connection discovery
invariants: Admin-only mutations; never adopt existing accounts or grant sudo/Docker. Disable blocks the personal UID before remote cleanup. Same-host clients require no SSH.
features.change_rule: Review host helper, private Admin CSRF routes, Sharing revocation, readonly MCP, installation/update/uninstall and Loom Use together.
live_validation: Verify external personal Tailscale login and revoke separately; mocks do not prove provider enforcement.

interfaces.name: Host account authority
interfaces.accepts: Restricted owner/action/username over protected Unix socket
interfaces.returns: Managed personal account state or failure; no arbitrary command execution

interfaces.name: SSH connection
interfaces.accepts: Authenticated principal
interfaces.returns: Only that principal connection metadata

features.summary: Private bounded local error collection; no remote telemetry
invariants: Collection failures never block authentication, Jobs or responses. No secret/request/exception-message capture and no automatic upload.
features.change_rule: Review every caller, image packaging, private volume ownership and independent Loom Use collector schema before changing collection fields.
live_validation: Tests cover filesystem faults and retention. External collection/upload is not implemented; client and server directories remain on their respective machines.

interfaces.name: Local incident
interfaces.accepts: Fixed component/operation/code and optional exception object
interfaces.returns: Incident ID or None on suppressed/unwritable output; bounded JSONL
